native_result.query: In the PCA conducted on forms of capital, analyzed in hundred-year time slices, how are the symbolic capital components such as house size, daggers, and hatchets/swords characterized in terms of their values on the first principal component (PC1) and distribution across the second principal component (PC2)?
native_result.HypoA: Symbolic capital components such as house size, the number of daggers, and hatchets/swords are characterized by negative values on the first principal component (PC1) and exhibit a wide distribution of values on the second principal component (PC2). This Principal component analysis (PCA) is on the forms of capital. The values of the individual elements of the forms of capital form the attributes.
native_result.HypoB: In the hundred-year-slice PCA of the 12 forms of capital, the symbolic-capital components form a coherent positive cluster on PC1 but fan out across PC2. On PC1 (31.8% of variance) all three load positively and moderately — hatchets/swords +0.570 (5th/12), daggers +0.529 (6th), house size +0.431 (10th) — clustering on the positive side without dominating it (PC1 is led by copper/gold +0.754, pottery decoration +0.720, pottery form -0.673, depot +0.658). Across PC2 (20.4% of variance) they are differentiated, not clustered: house size has the largest PC2 loading of the three (+0.551, 5th/12) while daggers (+0.181, 8th) and especially hatchets/swords (+0.101, 12th, ~0) load weakly, so PC2 separates house size from the two weapon types. This PC2 distribution is a static loading contrast modulated by period-specific swings rather than a monotonic time gradient (PC2 score vs BCE r~0.04; PC2 scores peak in the Mesolithic ~3400-3000 BCE and are lowest in the Early Neolithic and Young Bronze Age).
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded data/capital.csv (parsed European comma decimals; dropped group/color) -> 39 hundred-year slices x 12 standardized Z capital forms (BCE 4300-500). Ran correlation-matrix PCA via numpy SVD (sklearn unavailable) on the existing Z-values (no re-standardization, per approved A1). Computed EVR, structure-coefficient loadings (corr of each variable with each PC), per-slice PC1/PC2 scores, and per-slice values + PC2-weighted contributions of the three symbolic variables (Zhausgr, ZDolch, ZAxtSchwert). Fixed PC1/PC2 sign so the largest-|loading| variable is positive. Ranked all 12 variables on both axes by |loading|. Saved loading table, per-slice score table, and eigenvalues as artifacts.
